Hydroponic *basil* tends to thrive when you maintain a nutrient solution with a pH between 6.0 and 6.5, keep the water temperature steady around 65 to 70 degrees, and make sure the roots never dry out between waterings. Have you ever considered swapping in some *basil* to your hydroponic setup and seeing how it does?
